name: @starci/next-data
description: The data helpers of a StarCi Next.js front end over SWR, as pure logic with no component: the pollingRestart middleware (a function refreshInterval that stopped at 0 starts again when newer data makes it answer above 0), the viewer and tenant key helpers (a key carries every identity that changes the answer), the viewer-keyed cache config and the writes that reach the cache of the viewer on screen.
author: starci183

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const f of fs.readdirSync('dist', {recursive: true}).filter((n) => n.endsWith('.d.ts'))) fs.writeFileSync('dist/' + f, fs.readFileSync('dist/' + f, 'utf8').replace(/((?:from |import\()['\x22]\.\.?\/[^'\x22]+)\.ts(['\x22])/g, (all, head, quote) => head + '.js' + quote))"
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include="src/**/*.ts" --test-coverage-exclude="src/**/*.spec.ts" --test-coverage-lines=90 "src/**/*.spec.ts"
